claims.claim: An initial active-epoch ROM_READY does not arm the reboot latch, while a legitimate post-ready lifecycle command still reaches the bridge.
Presence admission overflow is independently wakeable and terminates the serving loop as stable PresenceQueueFull rather than reconnectable EOF.
The sole bridge-writer actor prevents a stalled lifecycle write from delaying an authenticated shutdown acknowledgment beyond the 500 ms regression bound.
Pre-ready presence is generation-stamped, discarded after readiness without consuming bridge sequence, and never replayed after authentication.
The repair delta is confined to server.rs while the staged control-v2 dependency remains byte-for-byte unchanged and the sealed candidate tree is exact.
